decisions.notes: Individually inspected the twelve views and the 4K base-color image: the aircraft and rigging are recognizable, but the model renders almost uniformly white and lacks useful material variation. It does not meet the desired realistic appearance.
limitations: The two embedded 4K images include an almost entirely white base-color map; dimensions alone do not imply detail.
Static model, no animation or armature; scale not independently verified.
One glTF validator warning for generated tangent space.
